artworks.title: Salomon and Cleopatra
artworks.description: The image depicts two individuals in profile view. On the left, an elderly man with a long beard and turban is shown. On the right, a young woman with a headscarf adorned with round objects across her forehead is shown facing the elderly man.

artworks.title: Salomon and Cleopatra
artworks.description: The image is a triptych featuring three distinct figures. On the left is an elderly man shown in profile, with a white beard, furrowed brow, a turban with a feather. In the center is a nude person holding a spear and shield, with short curly hair. On the right, a profile view of a woman looking right with a serene expression, decorated headpiece, wrapped headdress, and cascading hair. The background is a plain texture. The figures are labeled "SALAMON," an unnamed middle figure, and "CLEOPATRA."

artworks.title: The Betrayal of Christ
artworks.description: The image shows a group of figures in a dynamic scene. In the center, a man with long hair and a beard wearing a robe is surrounded by several soldiers wearing helmets and armor, some carrying shields and swords. To the right, another man peeks out from behind a wooden door. The surrounding environment includes a stone structure with an arched doorway and rugged terrain with sparse trees. Several soldiers with lances and shields are standing in the background. A soldier on the ground is holding his head.

artworks.title: Panel of Ornament
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Andrée and Jonathan Bober
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a decorative scene with putti and foliage. The artwork features a detailed and ornate depiction of three putti intertwined within an elaborate acanthus leaf motif. The composition is highly detailed, with intricate patterns of leaves and scrolls that frame the putti in a symmetrical manner. The leaves are textured, adding depth to the design. The figures appear in different poses, interacting with the surrounding foliage playfully. The style suggests a classical approach to decorative themes, reminiscent of Renaissance engravings.

artworks.title: Allegory of Love
artworks.artist: School of Marcantonio Raimondi, after Baccio Bandinelli(?)
artworks.description: This is a detailed drawing of a classical scene with mythological themes. The image shows various figures engaged in different activities with architectural elements and mythical creatures included. The central figure is surrounded by other characters in dynamic poses, set within a classical architectural backdrop. Horses and chariots fill the sky while the lower part of the image contains intricate symbols and text. The drawing is rich in symbolism and detail, reminiscent of Renaissance or Baroque allegorical artworks.

artworks.title: Title Page
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate title page. The central content features text within an oval frame, surrounded by intricate decorative elements. The title reads "LE SACRE ZODIAQUE" and provides information about its division into twelve months related to religious festivals. This oval frame is adorned with swirling patterns and flanked by two allegorical figures; one figure embodies themes of spring, holding a branch with flowers, and the other figure embodies harvest or autumn, holding a sheaf of wheat and a cornucopia. Below the frame, on the left, a cherubic figure sits on a barrel accompanied by fruits, suggesting abundance or celebratory themes. On the right, an elderly figure with a long beard is shown warming himself by a small fire. Detailed engravings of floral and vine motifs accentuate the corners, contributing to the rich border design of this decorative and symbolic illustration.

artworks.title: Les Feste du mois de Janvier (January: the Circumcision)
artworks.description: This is a drawing showing various religious scenes associated with the month of January. The image is divided into segments, depicting different Christian events and figures. The main section illustrates a religious ceremony with a group of figures gathered around a baby with a halo. The upper right segment shows the adoration of the Magi, with figures offering gifts to a child. The bottom right segment shows a saint-like figure with a halo, holding a staff and a book. Other depictions include saints labeled "S. Antoine" and "S. Sebastian" in the background. The text at the top identifies this as the festive celebrations of January ("Les Feste du Mois de Ianuier"). The drawing includes intricate details of religious art, with attention to architecture and expressions of the figures.

artworks.title: Les Festes du mois de Feburier (February: the Purification of the Virgin)
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting religious scenes associated with the month of February. It is titled "Les Festes du Mois de Fevrier" and features detailed illustrations of events like the purification of the Virgin Mary and St. Matthias' day. The drawing is created with fine lines, resembling an engraving. People in robes are depicted in the composition, which includes an archway with columns. Additionally, there are fish symbols representing the zodiac sign of Pisces, which corresponds to February. The setting combines landscapes and architecture, providing a historical context to the representation.

artworks.title: Les Festes du mois de Mars (March: The Annunciation)
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting religious scenes and figures associated with the month of March. The image shows various symbolic elements and figures, structured into different sections. One section features an angel kneeling and pointing upwards while holding a staff with a scroll. Opposite is a seated figure with a halo. Above are three scenes depicting different figures and landscapes, each with inscriptions related to religious celebrations in March. The artwork is highly detailed with fine lines and crosshatching, conveying a sense of divine intervention and tradition.

artworks.title: Les Festes du mois d'Avril (April: The Resurrection)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a resurrection scene. The central figure is in dramatic motion, ascending with a halo and holding a banner. Surrounding the central figure are clouds, and soldiers in classical attire at the lower portion of the scene. In the background to the left, there is a crucified figure on a cross. The landscape includes rolling hills and distant settlements. The artwork is intricately detailed with fine lines and shading typical of prints from the early modern period.

artworks.title: Les Festes du mois de Mai (May: The Ascension)
artworks.description: The image depicts multiple figures in a religious setting. In the upper part of the image, a figure representing Jesus is shown from head to toe, standing with arms outstretched, surrounded by rays of light and clouds. Below, a group of people are kneeling or seated on the ground, their heads lifted towards the central figure. They wear long robes typical of historical Biblical depictions. In the background are additional scenes with smaller figures engaged in various activities amidst natural landscapes and clouds, adding depth to the scene. The image is framed with the words "LES FESTES DV MOIS DE MAY" at the top and contains textual information in French at the bottom.

artworks.title: Les Festes du mois de Juin (June: The Pentecost)
artworks.description: This image depicts a detailed engraving featuring Christian religious themes. A group of robed figures appears to be gathered for prayer or worship, beneath a radiant dove symbolizing the Holy Spirit. Additional scenes include a woman and child in the top left corner, two standing figures with a religious artifact, and a single figure with a book and symbol on the right. Background elements like clouds and heavenly visions enhance the spiritual atmosphere. The engraving showcases intricate linework and classical architectural details.

artworks.title: Les Festes du mois de Juillet (July: The Visitation)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of religious figures engaging in various interactions. The image is filled with detailed engravings depicting a scene that illustrates several figures. In the foreground, multiple figures engage in a reverent exchange, with one figure extending a hand to another. The background features a rugged landscape with figures sitting or standing on the hills. Above the scene, there is a celestial symbol appearing amidst clouds. The script at the top reads "LES FESTES DV MOIS DE IVILLET," and further text at the bottom provides additional context in French. The ornate border and precise detail indicate this is a work of high craftsmanship, likely intended to represent or celebrate religious festivities or saints associated with the month of July.

artworks.title: Les Festes du mois d'Aoust (August: The Assumption)
artworks.description: The image shows a scene with a central woman figure on a pedestal. She is surrounded by radiant lines and cherubic faces. The woman has a serene expression, eyes closed, hands clasped in prayer, long flowing hair, a haloed veil, and is in flowing robes. Flanking her are two angels with wings. Other figures and inscriptions are also present, with a landscape background with mountains.

artworks.title: Les Festes du mois de Septembre (September: Birth of the Virgin)
artworks.description: This drawing portrays various religious scenes associated with the month of September. The central composition is divided into sections depicting different events within a larger rectangle. On the left side, there are scenes set against a mountainous landscape, including armored figures, serene figures interacting with celestial beings, and a cross with inscriptions below each scene. On the right side, the focus shifts indoors, showing a figure resting in an elaborate canopy bed, attendants engaged in various activities, such as preparing food and caring for a child. The drawing is detailed, with figures in dynamic poses, and shading and crosshatching convey depth and texture. Above the scenes, a scale is depicted among the clouds, with text detailing the "Festes du Mois de September".

artworks.title: Les Festes du mois de Octobre (October: Saint Luke)
artworks.description: The image features several figures, with a seated man in the foreground. The man is seated at a desk with an open book, pointing to it with one hand and holding a scroll in the other. He wears a robe and a feathered cap. Next to him is a winged ox. In the background, there are figures labeled as S. Simon, S. Jude, S. François, and S. Denis in a landscape. The scene is enclosed and decorated with bottles and books. The background shows architectural elements and a sky with clouds, a zodiac symbol, and the sun shining on one of the saints. The image is detailed with inscriptions referencing October and a poem in the lower section.

artworks.title: Les Festes du mois de November (November: All Saints)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of religious figures and symbolism associated with the month of November. The image is divided into sections with intricate detailing, depicting various scenes and characters. In the upper half of the drawing, a heavenly gathering is illustrated, centered around a divine figure surrounded by rays of light. Other figures surround the central character, each with symbolic items like keys and crosses. Below, terrestrial depictions highlight prominent religious figures with names beneath them such as St. Andrew, St. Martin, St. Marcel, and St. Catherine, engaged in acts that reflect their stories. The composition is rich with symbolic imagery such as a winged horse in the clouds, a dove, and rays of light emanating from central figures. The scene is infused with religious and mythological references.

artworks.title: Les Festes du mois de Decembre (December: The Nativity)
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting various religious figures and events celebrated in December, centered around a nativity scene. The image shows Saint Nicholas, the conception of the Virgin Mary, Saint Thomas, Saint John the Evangelist, Stephen the First Martyr, and the Holy Innocents, along with corresponding celebration dates. The foreground features the nativity of Jesus in a stable with animals. The artwork is detailed with intricate lines and shading reminiscent of religious engravings from the Renaissance era.

artworks.title: Sacrifice of a Ram
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a procession with a banquet scene. The image depicts a lively procession of figures, mostly women dressed in flowing classical robes, moving towards the right. They are engaged in what appears to be a ceremonial or festive occasion. The figures carry various objects such as baskets or vessels, and some are dancing. On the far right, the drawing transitions to an interior setting, where seated figures appear to be partaking in a banquet, with food and drink on the table. The background is intricately decorated with garlands and ornate architectural details.

artworks.title: Satyrs Bringing Animals to an Altar
artworks.description: This is a drawing of mythical creatures engaged in a procession. The image depicts a group of mythical creatures with human-like upper bodies and goat-like lower bodies. Some creatures are playing musical instruments and others are carrying garlands of flowers and foliage. The setting includes architectural elements like columns and a building, suggesting a gathering. The drawing style uses delicate lines to render details in clothing and facial expressions, creating a lively atmosphere.

artworks.title: Sacrifice of a Satyr
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene featuring a procession or celebration. The artwork depicts various figures in flowing garments, engaged in a ceremonial or festive event. Many figures are holding objects such as wreaths, staffs, or musical instruments. The drawing shows intricate detailing and a balance between the movement of the figures and the backdrop's ornamentation, with drapes and decorative elements adding depth to the scene. The composition suggests a sense of rhythm and continuity as the figures interact gracefully with one another, evoking a harmonious and lively tableau.

artworks.title: Female Satyr with Children on an Altar
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene featuring numerous figures engaged in ceremonial or celebratory activities. The image depicts a tableau of characters, with some figures participating in dancing or playing musical instruments while others are involved in a ritual or festive gathering. Decorative elements include drapery, garlands hanging overhead, vases, and a detailed altar or podium around which some of the activity is centered. The figures are dressed in flowing garments typical of classical attire and the scene includes symbolic objects such as a bow and quiver. The intricate details and composition suggest a carefully staged narrative conveyed through the interactions and gestures of the figures present.

artworks.title: Dancing Nymphs and Satyrs
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a festive gathering with mythical creatures and figures engaged in dancing and merriment. On the left, a satyr-like creature plays a flute near a pedestal with a statue of a woman. In the center, a group of dancers includes male and female figures holding hands in a circle. To the right, there is a seated gathering around a round table with various figures sitting and reclining, including small cherub-like figures. The backdrop is decorated with foliage, creating a celebratory atmosphere. The drawing features detailed line work typical of classical or Renaissance-styled prints.

artworks.title: Putto Herding Goats through Garlands
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring figures and goats in a natural setting. The scene depicts various figures in flowing garments interacting with goats and cherubic entities. The composition includes a detailed natural background with trees and foliage. The figures are dynamically posed. The intricate line work and attention to garment drapery suggest a richly detailed piece.
